test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The founder and chairman of which of the following companies topped the EdelGive-Hurun India Philanthropy List 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**HCL Technologies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **HCL Technologies** is an Indian multinational information technology (IT) services and consulting company.
 
• The founder and chairman of **HCL Technologies** is **Shiv Nadar**.
 
• **Shiv Nadar** has topped the **EdelGive-Hurun India Philanthropy List 2024**, recognizing his significant contributions to philanthropy.
 
• HCL Technologies is headquartered in **Noida, India**.
 
• The company operates in over **50 countries** and has a worldwide network of R&D, innovation labs, and delivery centers.
 
• HCL Technologies provides services including **software development, business process outsourcing (BPO), and IT infrastructure management**.
 
• The company is one of the top IT services companies in India and is known for its innovation and customer-centric approach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reliance Industries**__

 __
 
• **Reliance Industries** is an Indian multinational conglomerate company headquartered in **Mumbai, India**.
 
• The company is involved in businesses across sectors such as **petrochemicals, refining, oil, telecommunications, and retail**.
 
• It is one of the largest companies in India in terms of market capitalization and revenue.
 
 
 
• **WIPRO**__
 __
 
• **WIPRO** Limited is an Indian multinational corporation that provides **information technology, consulting, and business process services**.
 
• Headquartered in **Bengaluru, India**, WIPRO is one of the largest IT services companies in India.
 
• It was founded by **Mohamed Premji** in 1945.
 
 
 
• **TCS**__
 
 
• **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company.
 
• It is headquartered in **Mumbai, India**, and operates in 46 countries.
 
• TCS is a part of the **Tata Group**, one of India's largest and oldest industrial conglomerates.
